HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 21.04.2023 CRL.M.A. 10632/2023(Exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
1. This petitions has been filed for regular bail in FIR No. 81/2021 under Sections 420/120B/34 IPC.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
3. The petitioner was arrested on 12th April, 2021.
Learned counsel for the petitioner states that petitioner was on bail on the basis of HPC recommendations and pursuant to the orders of Hon'ble Supreme Court had to surrender.
4. As per the learned counsel for the petitioner, the petitioner wife is seven months pregnant and notwithstanding his regular bail, he seeks interim bail in the meantime.
5. The State shall verify these facts and place it as part of the Status Report.
Nominal Roll may also be requisitioned from the Jail Superintendent from the Jail Superintendant and placed on record before the next date of hearing.

6. List 01st May, 2023.
7. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J APRIL 21, 2023/RK Mange Ram vs The State Nct Of Delhi on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199975572/
